description: Graveyard Keeper +3 DLC (native Linux, GOG v1.405 build 55214)
long: Graveyard Keeper is a darkly comic medieval cemetery-management simulation in which the player inherits a graveyard and must tend graves, gather resources, craft, cook and build a business while cutting morally dubious corners. It mixes survival and RPG progression with a branching story and a satirical tone. This package bundles three DLC and runs as a native Linux build from GOG.
